title: Inside Coober Pedy: The Australian desert town where thousands escaped 50°C heat by building an entire underground world beneath the Earth
summary_full: Coober Pedy, Australia, features a unique town built underground by opal miners.  Residents live below the surface to escape the harsh desert climate and high cooling costs.  This subterranean living provides stable temperatures year-round, offering practical comfort and savings.  Underground homes and businesses are common, transforming excavated mining areas into functional spaces.  The town's success depends on specific geological conditions and dry weather for construction.
